title: Base overlays: skip slicer tracking paths (.slicer/, landed-changed/) in the other-file git show list

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Follow-up of S618 (run ork-20261126-021911-97a7). Every real relay diff holds .slicer/ tracking files and landed-changed/ID.md, so the per-file git show list S618 adds to the Base overlays section fills with tracking paths up to its 20-path cap. Filter them the way trackingPath does elsewhere (and as adj 600 does for the no-renders rule), with a test.

Owner decision, 2026-11-26 (key base-overlays.tracking-paths): land S618 as specced and file this follow-up (Jon chose 'Follow-up').
